name: GitHub REST API issues (write)
description: Write operation family of the GitHub REST Issues API (create issues). Separated from the read item because the side effect and required permission differ.

provenance.notes: Supports API version 2026-03-10 and 'Issues' repository permissions (write) for Create an issue. Update an issue was not visible in the fetched excerpt. required_scopes uses this project's notation '<fine-grained permission>:<access>' for the GitHub fine-grained token permission named on the endpoint page; auth_methods api_key represents a fine-grained personal access token (bearer token). OAuth app and GitHub App installation tokens were not verified today and are omitted.
Content-creating requests: 80 per minute and 500 per hour secondary limits; POST/PATCH cost 5 points.
